title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 10 in E minor

character.text: Galant concert fugue in a dance metre, free of learned devices

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 48–49).

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G major (Soprano); Answer in D major (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 19–23), in the same voices, a fourth lower. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
